title: 4. Um pouco sobre abordagem e conquista

queries.text: "impressionismo" is the author’s word for the art of making an impression; kept as "impressionism" (also in 05-0018). Alternative: "making an impression".
"à desatenção exclusiva por parte de um homem" read as a man’s inattention singling her out ("singular inattention"). Alternative: "inattention from one particular man".

Portuguese "atingir" means both "to reach/affect" and "to hit"; the author’s disclaimer plays on the second sense. Rendered "reach" (heading and here), which loses the "hit" ambiguity. Alternative: "strike", which keeps the violent sense the author disclaims.
Film cited by its Brazilian title "Hitch: Conselheiro Amoroso"; the original title is "Hitch" (Andy Tennant, 2005).
Idiom "não dão agulhadas sem dedal" (lit. "they don’t ply the needle without a thimble") rendered "they never take a risk without protection".
"algum vadio" (masculine of the glossary’s "vadia" → "tramp") rendered "tramp", consistent with 02-0016 ("homens vadios" → "male tramps").
Nietzsche’s Übermensch ("Além do Homem" in the author’s Portuguese) rendered "Overman". Alternatives: "Superman", "Beyond-Man".
